description: Tagged pairs for the play-conflict exclusivity algorithm shared by mtg-decks scripts/check_plays.py and the api's plays check. Each case is two play fragments (when, opposing_archetypes, true, false). An exclusive case lists every dimension that proves it (proven_by, in dimension order); a conflicting case proves none and lists the dimensions the pair overlaps on. An errored case is judged by the same algorithm (proven_by, dimensions) but fragment b carries the error codes the gate raises against its file (errors); a play with any error is left out of conflict computation, so the gate reports those errors and no warning. Both repos hold this file byte-identical.

dimensions.name: whose_turn
dimensions.rule: when.whose_turn is mine in one and theirs in the other

dimensions.name: opposing_archetypes
dimensions.rule: the plays' archetype sets do not intersect; a play's set is its opposing_archetypes list (every archetype when the list holds *) narrowed by each of its conditions on the built-in opposing_archetype input, a false-list condition negated first

dimensions.name: stack
dimensions.rule: one play's when.stack is empty and the other has a stack_top condition in true

dimensions.name: pending_decision
dimensions.rule: an explicit pending_decision true condition, or a declare_attackers/declare_blockers first move (the runtime's other priority-gate relaxation), names a decision kind a play can only run in answer to; two plays naming disjoint, nonempty sets of those kinds cannot both apply

dimensions.name: input
dimensions.rule: an input condition in each play on the same name whose value sets cannot both hold; a false-list condition is negated first

dimensions.name: true_false
dimensions.rule: a normalized condition is in one play's true and the other's false

dimensions.name: numeric_range
dimensions.rule: count, zone_size, life, untapped_mana or int-input conditions on the same key whose ranges cannot overlap; a false-list condition is negated first

dimensions.name: pass_fallback
dimensions.rule: a play whose only move is pass never conflicts with a play that has a real move (FD2 item 7b); two pass-only plays are not covered and still conflict the ordinary way

dimensions.name: move_selector
dimensions.rule: the two plays' first moves' own card lookups (cast/play_land's card, activate/keyword_action's source/card) provably cannot match the same object: a different determinate zone, or a disjoint non-empty types_all/types_any or keywords_any set (FD2 item 7b)

inputs.name: plan
inputs.description: The line the agent has committed to this game.

inputs.name: hold_up_interaction
inputs.description: Whether the agent prefers to keep mana open on the opponent's turn.

inputs.name: opponent_clock
inputs.description: Turns the agent expects the opponent to need to win.

cases.name: archetypes-list-vs-built-in-input-overlapping

cases.name: errored-unknown-archetype-key-is-left-out-of-conflicts

cases.name: errored-never-applicable-empty-stack-and-stack-top
cases.note: an empty stack has no top: b can never apply

cases.name: errored-never-applicable-one-condition-true-and-false
cases.note: one normalized condition must both hold and not hold: b can never apply

cases.name: errored-never-applicable-numeric-range-in-one-play

cases.name: numeric-turn-le-2-vs-ge-3

cases.name: numeric-turn-le-2-vs-ge-2
cases.note: turn 2 satisfies both

cases.name: missing-from-count-at-least-one-vs-none-same-selector
cases.note: one selector with missing_from is one key: at least one missing piece and none cannot both hold

cases.name: missing-from-count-at-least-one-vs-below-one-zones-reordered
cases.note: missing_from zones are a set, so reordered zones are the same key

cases.name: missing-from-same-condition-true-and-false
cases.note: the same missing_from count in one play's true and the other's false

cases.name: missing-from-selectors-differ-only-in-missing-from
cases.note: a library Tower beside a battlefield Tower: no piece is missing, yet the library holds one, so both apply; selectors differing only in missing_from are different keys

cases.name: missing-from-different-zones
cases.note: missing from the battlefield and hand, and yet present in the graveyard: different zones are different keys

cases.name: pending-decision-different-kinds
cases.note: a seat holds at most one pending decision at once

cases.name: pending-decision-same-kind-is-not-exclusive
cases.note: the same pending kind on both sides proves nothing

cases.name: pending-decision-declare-attackers-vs-declare-blockers
cases.note: combat moves: a declare_attackers play and a declare_blockers play are exclusive by decision, the same proof as two differing pending_decision conditions

cases.name: compare-true-vs-identical-false-is-exclusive
cases.note: compare is canonicalised as one literal, the same as any other condition

cases.name: compare-different-conditions-do-not-falsely-claim-numeric-range
cases.note: compare's own op/n never register as a NUMERIC_KINDS condition; no false numeric_range

cases.name: all-of-is-one-literal-not-decomposed-for-true-false
cases.note: a bare member of an all_of never matches the all_of itself

cases.name: pass-fallback-pass-only-vs-move-bearing
cases.note: a play whose only move is pass is a fallback that never conflicts with a move-bearing play

cases.name: pass-fallback-two-pass-only-plays-still-conflict
cases.note: the fallback exemption names exactly one side pass-only; two identical pass-only plays are not exempted

cases.name: move-selector-different-zones
cases.note: a card is in exactly one zone at a time - battlefield and hand never coincide

cases.name: move-selector-overlapping-types-still-conflict
cases.note: types_any: [Instant, Creature] and types_all: [Creature] are not disjoint - a Creature could match either - so the pair still conflicts
